scenario: A capture-bearing match binds in `where` with the capture form ([LREG.4.1]), and an ordinary predicate may follow it on the same clause and read the captures. Pin: `where (device, code) = e.msg ~ /(?<device>\w+) on (?<code>\d+)/ and code == "42"` compiles. Path: `dsc.parse.lgra_8_3_4_take_where` keeps the whole `and` chain as the gating condition and takes its leftmost conjunct as the destructured match; `code` in the trailing conjunct lowers to FN_REGEX_CAPTURE group 2 (`dsc.rete.lreg_4_1_capture_expr`).
rules_ds:
schema Log scope logical:
    msg: String key

rule r:
    Log e where (device, code) = e.msg ~ /(?<device>\w+) on (?<code>\d+)/ and code == "42"
->
    log info "{device}"
